gear.quality: ISO 1328 grade 8 to 9 (stock cut m1 aluminium gear) [A]
gear.centre_error_to_backlash: each 0.01 mm of centre-distance error changes normal backlash by 2 x 0.01 x tan 20 deg = 0.0073 mm
gear.recommend: design normal backlash 0.05 mm (0.15 deg at the joint); bore the gear and pinion bearing seats in one setup or ream them in a drilling jig so the centre distance holds +-0.02 mm; a printed socket alone holds about +-0.1 mm, which swings the backlash from 0 (binding) to 0.12 mm. Set the nominal centre 0.05 mm long (30.05 mm) if the seats stay as printed.

fits.item: 61803 outer ring (26 mm) in printed socket boss
fits.load: outer ring stationary against a mostly fixed load direction
fits.fit: light press, 0.03 to 0.08 mm interference on the as-printed bore (print 25.90, ream or sand to fit)
fits.note: PETG grows 0.06 mm more than the steel ring at +40 K: a 0.03 mm press is gone by +20 K. Bond the ring with epoxy or keep a lip and a cap.

fits.item: 61803 inner ring (17 mm) on the 7075 gear spigot
fits.load: inner ring turns +-55 deg under a load fixed to the socket: rotating inner-ring load
fits.fit: 17 k5 (+0.012 / +0.001) on a solid spigot; the hollow spigot as drawn is thin, so 17 j5 (+0.005 / -0.003) plus retaining compound
fits.note: aluminium grows 0.008 mm more than the ring at +40 K, which tightens this fit slightly

fits.item: 695 outer ring (13 mm) in the printed bearing cap
695 inner ring on the 5 mm pinion stub
6705 outer ring (32 mm) in the printed lid ring, joints 1 to 4
6705 inner ring (25 mm) on the printed fork sleeve, joints 1 to 4
fits.load: inner ring turns with the fork: rotating inner-ring load
fits.fit: 0.05 to 0.10 mm interference on a sanded sleeve (print 25.20, sand to fit); a printed sleeve creeps, so bond it
fits.note: the sleeve grows into the ring when warm (tightens 0.04 mm at +40 K); the risk is creep at room temperature

fits.item: 8 mm 7075 idler pin in the printed cheek (joint 0) or cradle back (joints 1 to 4)
fits.fit: pin 8 h6 (0 / -0.009); printed hole 7.80 to 7.85 mm, pressed (0.15 to 0.2 mm into PETG) or bonded in an 8.0 mm hole

fits.item: Fork idler ear on the 8 mm pin or stub (running)
fits.fit: running clearance 0.05 to 0.10 mm diametral: print the bore at 8.0 and ream 8.05 to 8.10, or press an 8 x 10 x 4 mm PTFE or iglide bushing into a 10 mm bore
fits.note: as drawn the bore is 8.4 mm (0.4 mm clearance): see the stack-up

fits.item: Horn screws, 4 x M3 through the 4 mm fork horn ear
fits.load: joint torque by clamp friction, then by the screw shanks
fits.fit: clearance hole 3.4 mm as drawn; ream 3.1 mm (or print 3.0 and drill 3.1)
fits.note: see the horn clamp check: PETG relaxes the clamp, and then the hole clearance becomes backlash

fits.fit: +-0.02 mm with reamed seats; +0.05 mm nominal if printed
fits.note: the printed socket grows 0.05 mm more than the gears at +40 K, which adds 0.04 mm of backlash when hot

fits.fit: +-0.2 mm per printed vertebra (FDM, along the arm axis)
fits.note: 13 in a row: +-2.6 mm worst case, +-0.7 mm RSS in arm length

fits.item: PTFE thrust washer, idler ear to cradle floor
fits.fit: 0.5 mm washer; end play 0.05 to 0.15 mm, set with 0.1 mm shims
0.5 mm clearance per side as drawn; the lid clamps it

horn_clamp.note: new, the clamp holds more than stall on every joint; once the PETG relaxes it holds less than an STS3250's stall, and then the 0.4 mm hole clearance adds up to 1.6 deg of play at that joint. Fix: ream the holes to 3.1 mm, add metal washers under the heads, or bond the ear to the horn.

stackup_note: play only: servo backlash 0.5 deg [A, no maker figure], halved by the 2:1 stage plus the stage's own; idler bore clearance tilts the fork about the two cross axes over the 49 mm ear span; horn-hole slip once the clamp has relaxed. Uniform within each play, 20,000 samples. Gravity or thrust usually preloads every joint to one side of its play, so the repeatable error under a steady load is far smaller than these numbers; they are what the tip can wander when the load reverses.

length_tolerance.note: PETG and servo cases taken together at 60e-6 per K [A]
